properties.name: Datalogger and Sensor Arrays
properties.description: Install a datalogger and sensor arrays on the Lake Vanda ice and in the moat region to measure heat flux within the lake-ice system.

properties.name: Plant Community Photosynthesis
properties.description: Test the suitability of pulse amplitude fluorometry for identification of active photosynthesis within a range of plant communities.

properties.name: Lake Ice and Water Column Measurements
properties.description: Undertake a series of vertical and horizontal profiles in Lake Vanda to determine temporal and spatial variability in ice thickness and transparency and water column temperature.

properties.name: Lake Bathymetry
properties.description: Use an autonomous surface vessel (ASV) and an RPAS to map the extent and bathymetry of the Lake Vanda moat zone at a time close to its maximum extent.

properties.name: Lake Level Monitoring
properties.description: To establish a new benchmark at Lake Vanda to allow ongoing monitoring of lake level rise.

properties.name: Sensor Transect Deployment
properties.description: To record soil temperature and summer water content.

properties.name: Vegetation Transects
properties.description: To establish a series of transects through natural wetness gradients in the Pyramid Trough wetlands and document the vegetation present and the elevation.

properties.name: Cyanobacterial Reflectance Measurements
properties.description: Use robotic and manual techniques to assess the spectral reflectance of cyanobacterial and moss communities at the Boulder Pavement and Pyramid Trough.
